title: Find the Falling Pressure
subtitle: Isolate the leaking branch with the independent mechanical gauge

candidates.label: Main Air Tank
candidates.summary: Primary reserve shell and regulator hold steady at 100 relative test units.

candidates.label: Habitat Trunk Line
candidates.summary: Main crew breathing supply. Isolating this trunk stops the leak and the habitat's air supply too.

candidates.label: Garden Feedthrough Collar
candidates.summary: Bulkhead collar shaken by the shallow moonquake; manual tap falls from 82 at t0 to 74 at t10.

candidates.label: Return Manifold
candidates.summary: Return circulation loop holds steady at 100 relative test units across the 10-second check.

candidates.label: Airlock Inner Seal
candidates.summary: Inner hatch lip is clean and seated; no differential drop across the airlock boundary.

candidates.label: Annex Branch Feed
candidates.summary: Phase-2 aftershock trips the branch indicator; automatic isolation holds when verified.

stages.title: Stage 1 · Learn: Trust the Mechanical Gauge
stages.goal: Equip the independent mechanical gauge, read the panel warning, identify the three test taps, and predict which branch is falling.

stages.title: Stage 2 · Apply: Six Candidates, Two Checks Per Phase
stages.goal: Record t0 and t10 readings across MAIN (100→100), GARDEN (82→74), and RETURN (100→100), inspect candidates within the 2-per-phase limit, and preview isolating the garden branch.

stages.title: Stage 3 · Twist: Aftershock, Clamp, and Reconciled Ledger
stages.goal: Verify annex auto-isolation after the phase-2 aftershock, isolate GARDEN, seat the repair clamp, slow-reopen for 5 steady 100/100/100 readings, fix the copied paper note, and inspect the N.R. annex hatch by camera at zero differential.

guided_intro.headline: Find the leaking branch without cutting crew air
guided_intro.why_now: After the shallow moonquake, air is dropping by 1 unit each phase on top of crew breathing. The electronic board is noisy, so you must test three taps with the mechanical gauge.
guided_intro.first_step: Predict which branch is falling, then attach the mechanical gauge to MAIN, GARDEN, and RETURN at t0 and t10.

explainer_clip.title: How Differential Pressure Isolation Works
steps: Attach the mechanical gauge to each test tap (MAIN, GARDEN, RETURN) at t0 and again 10 seconds later (t10).
A steady 100 → 100 reading means the branch is tight. A falling 82 → 74 reading reveals the active leak.
Close only the leaking branch valve, verify pressure holds, seat the repair clamp, and reopen slowly for 5 steady checks.

prediction.prompt: Before running the 10-second comparison, which branch do you predict is losing pressure after the moonquake?

options.label: Main Reserve Tap
options.response: Prediction logged: Main Reserve. Compare t0 and t10 gauge readings to test your hypothesis.

options.label: Garden Branch Tap
options.response: Prediction logged: Garden Branch. Compare t0 and t10 gauge readings to see if the bulkhead feedthrough is falling.

options.label: Return Line Tap
options.response: Prediction logged: Return Line. Compare t0 and t10 gauge readings to test your hypothesis.

role_cards.name: Amara
role_cards.quote: Do not guess with a wrench. Read the taps first.
facts: The independent mechanical gauge reads MAIN 100 → 100, GARDEN 82 → 74, and RETURN 100 → 100 over 10 seconds.
Each investigation phase uses 1 air for crew breathing plus 1 air for the unresolved leak until sealed before phase 4 (Air 10 → 3).

role_cards.name: Kai
role_cards.quote: The aftershock flipped the annex indicator, not the seal.
facts: During phase 2 an aftershock trips the annex branch indicator; verify its automatic isolation before reopening the garden.
Four daylight phases at DIM light and air maker OFF add +8 solar and spend 2 per phase (Battery 14 → 18, capped at 20).

role_cards.name: Mei
role_cards.quote: Alo and Tara can ride out a brief branch isolation while we seat the clamp.
facts: Briefly isolating the garden branch while seating the bulkhead clamp keeps Alo at 6 and Garden health at 8.
Four phases consume 1.2 food days per phase (Food 18.0 → 13.2 days).

role_cards.name: Rafi
role_cards.quote: Fix the note when the note is wrong, not the valve that passed five checks.
facts: Six candidate locations can be inspected, with at most 2 inspections per phase.
When a copied paper note conflicts with a tested valve, fix the note; inspect the N.R. annex hatch by camera only after confirming zero differential.

trade_study.prompt: Select the isolation plan that stops the 82 → 74 drop without cutting crew breathing air:

options.label: Isolate Garden Branch Only
options.cost: Garden isolated briefly · Crew air stays online · Leak stopped before phase 4

options.label: Isolate Habitat Trunk
options.cost: Stops the leak and the habitat's air supply too

options.label: Close Main Reserve Valve
options.cost: Triggers Flight Rule FR-02 Protected Reserve Warning

go_no_go_poll.prompt: Confirm Go/No-Go across all four stations before isolating the garden branch:

stations.label: Life Support (Amara)
stations.call: GO — Main reserve at 100; garden tap isolated on standby.

stations.label: Power & Piping (Kai)
stations.call: GO — Annex automatic isolation verified after phase-2 tremor.

stations.label: Garden Bay (Mei)
stations.call: GO — Alo and Tara buffered for brief collar clamp repair.

stations.label: Flight Rules (Rafi)
stations.call: GO — Rollback path verified if main pressure drops.

odf_steps.label: 2. Verify MAIN holds 100 and isolated GARDEN holds 74
3. Seat repair clamp on garden feedthrough collar from safe side
4. Reopen GARDEN valve slowly and verify 5 steady 100/100/100 checks

close_main_valve.label: Close MAIN Reserve Valve
close_main_valve.feedback: Closing MAIN cuts the station's primary reserve. Flight Rule FR-02 raises a Protected Reserve Warning and reopens MAIN immediately.

isolate_habitat_trunk.label: Isolate Habitat Trunk
isolate_habitat_trunk.feedback: This stops the leak and the habitat's air supply too. Leave the habitat trunk open and isolate only the leaking garden branch.

clamp_before_isolation.label: Seat Clamp Before Isolating Garden
clamp_before_isolation.feedback: The repair clamp cannot latch cleanly against a pressurised leaking collar. Isolate the GARDEN valve first, then seat the clamp from the safe side.

clamp_wrong_branch.label: Seat Clamp on Return Line
clamp_wrong_branch.feedback: RETURN held 100 → 100. Clamping an intact line leaves the garden feedthrough leaking.

fast_reopen_garden.label: Snap Garden Valve Open Fast
fast_reopen_garden.feedback: A fast reopen hammers the newly clamped collar. Reopen GARDEN slowly and verify five steady readings 2 seconds apart.

change_valve_to_match_bad_note.label: Change Tested Valve to Match Copied Paper Note
change_valve_to_match_bad_note.feedback: The valve just passed five consecutive 100/100/100 mechanical gauge checks. Correct the copied paper note to match the physical evidence, not the valve.

open_annex_hatch_unverified.label: Open N.R. Annex Hatch Directly
open_annex_hatch_unverified.feedback: Never open an unverified bulkhead hatch. Isolate the annex feed, confirm zero pressure differential, and inspect inside by camera only.

EX-CH03-S01.headline: Equip the mechanical gauge and identify the three pressure taps
EX-CH03-S01.instruction: Read the noisy manifold warning, equip the independent mechanical gauge, and locate the MAIN, GARDEN, and RETURN taps.

EX-CH03-S02.headline: Compare t0 and t10 tap readings and inspect the six candidates
EX-CH03-S02.instruction: Record t0 readings (100, 82, 100), inspect up to 2 candidates per phase, then record t10 readings (100, 74, 100) to confirm the garden branch is falling.

EX-CH03-S03.headline: Verify annex isolation, preview garden isolation, and confirm rollback
EX-CH03-S03.instruction: Check the phase-2 aftershock annex isolation, compare isolating GARDEN against isolating the habitat trunk, and confirm the rollback plan.

EX-CH03-S04.headline: Isolate GARDEN, seat the collar clamp, and log five steady readings
EX-CH03-S04.instruction: Close GARDEN only, verify MAIN holds 100 and GARDEN holds 74, seat the repair clamp, reopen slowly, and record five 100/100/100 checks.

EX-CH03-S05.headline: Reconcile the mismatched paper note with the tested valve
EX-CH03-S05.instruction: Keep the tested valve setting, correct the copied paper note to match physical evidence, and save the monitoring handover.

EX-CH03-S06.headline: Isolate the annex feed, confirm zero differential, and inspect the N.R. hatch
EX-CH03-S06.instruction: Close the annex feed, verify zero pressure differential across the hatch, and inspect the N.R. annex by camera before suited entry.

hints: Close GARDEN, clamp its feedthrough, reopen and verify five steady readings.
